issues.issue: Whether the MLC committed crimes against humanity between 2000 and 2003
issues.respondent_position: MLC committed murder, torture, cannibalism and child recruitment; reliable sources show systematic abuses.
issues.result_text: MLC committed crimes against humanity from 2000 to 2003.

issues.issue: Whether the claimant was an MLC member during 2000-2003 and whether his account is credible
issues.applicant_position: Joined MLC only in 2004; 2002 committee role was not MLC membership; testimony corrected.
issues.respondent_position: Refugee form and 2009 interview show MLC membership from 2000; account changed at hearing.
issues.result_text: Court believes claimant was an MLC member from 2000 until leaving the DRC; his changed account is not credible.

issues.issue: Whether the claimant is complicit in the MLC's crimes against humanity under article 1F(a), and whether the presumption is rebutted
issues.applicant_position: Denied knowledge of atrocities and minimized them; did not share the organization's purpose.
issues.respondent_position: Membership in an organization with a brutal purpose presumes complicity; claimant knew of abuses and stayed.
issues.result_text: Claimant did not rebut the presumption of complicity in MLC crimes against humanity from 2000 to 2004.

issues.issue: Whether MLC acts also amount to war crimes, crimes against peace or acts contrary to UN purposes (article 1F(a) and (c))
issues.respondent_position: Minister alleges serious reasons to consider exclusion under article 1F(a) and (c).
issues.result_text: Court found crimes against humanity and need not consider other article 1F notions.
